name: Ponte Vedra
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Ponte Vedra, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Ponte Vedra, FL: Palm Valley Boat Parade, Breakfast with Santa at Ponte Vedra Inn & Club, Nocatee events and Santa visits.
lede: Ponte Vedra celebrates Christmas on the water and at its resorts, with a lighted boat parade on the Intracoastal in Palm Valley, Santa breakfasts and hayrides at Ponte Vedra Inn & Club, and holiday festivals in Nocatee.
celebrates: The Palm Valley Boat Parade sends lighted boats up seven miles of the Intracoastal Waterway, with bleacher seating at the Palm Valley Bridge. Ponte Vedra Inn & Club's holiday calendar lists Photos with Santa, Santa Hayrides, Breakfast with Santa, Cookies, Carols, and Cocoa by the fire pits and a Gingerbread Reveal. Sawgrass Marriott hosts Teddy Bear Tea with holiday crafts. Nocatee's A Glow festival has a Christmas Village, a petting zoo and a trackless train, but it is set up for residents and their guests. Families also attend Santa visits at local halls and community centers.
lastyear: Last year, Nocatee Living's own post announced Nocatee A Glow for Friday, December 5 and Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 6:30 to 9:30 pm inside Spray Waterpark and Nocatee Station Field, with Santa and Mrs. Claus on the schedule. Nocatee calls it the community's most spectacular event of the year, and it is built for residents and their guests, so many visitors plan other stops, such as the Palm Valley boat parade or a resort Santa breakfast.
facts: The Palm Valley Boat Parade's own website says it has run since 1993 and is built by volunteers, with St. Johns County Parks and Recreation and the Palm Valley Community Association as presenting partners. Ponte Vedra Inn & Club says it has set the standard for iconic Florida beach resorts since 1928. The Florida's Historic Coast tourism calendar lists the parade route as seven miles of the Intracoastal, starting one mile south of the bridge.
trains: Ponte Vedra families who want trains usually look north or south. The Florida East Coast Railway, which Henry Flagler built up from St. Augustine, still runs freight over nearly the same route he developed, and its offices are in Jacksonville. In St. Augustine, Ripley's Red Train Tours runs a 30 minute Nights of Lights ride, and Rally's guide to the 1919 Jacksonville Terminal covers the area's rail history.
train_links: The 1919 rail terminal in Jacksonville, now the Prime F. Osborn III Convention Center.
Volunteers sharing Florida East Coast Railway history, with free public events.
traditions: Lighted boats on the Intracoastal Waterway, watched from the Palm Valley Bridge and nearby docks.
Santa at Ponte Vedra Inn & Club
Photos with Santa, Santa Hayrides and a Breakfast with Santa are on the resort's holiday calendar.
A beachside evening at the Inn with fire pits, hot chocolate, cookies and festive music.
Holiday tea at Vernon's at Sawgrass Marriott, with a keepsake craft and a teddy bear for each child.
The Nocatee community's holiday weekend with a Christmas Village, photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus and a light show.
kidfact: At Teddy Bear Tea, every child gets a special teddy bear, and the Sawgrass Marriott says kids can bring their own teddy bear or doll too.
faq: Is there a Christmas boat parade in Ponte Vedra?

Yes. The Palm Valley Boat Parade is a volunteer run lighted boat parade on the Intracoastal Waterway that has run since 1993. It starts one mile south of the Palm Valley Bridge and travels north, and it is free to watch. The bridge at 6 Roscoe Boulevard is the popular viewing spot, with first come bleacher seating.
Where can kids see Santa in Ponte Vedra?

Options include Breakfast with Santa and Photos with Santa at Ponte Vedra Inn & Club, Santa Hayrides at the Inn and free Santa photos at community events such as the Visit with Santa event at American Legion Post 233 in Palm Valley. Resort events have set prices and some need reservations, so check each host.
Can the public go to Nocatee A Glow?

Nocatee describes A Glow as an event for residents and their guests. Guests must be accompanied by a resident and each guest needs a ticket, which Nocatee lists at $15 in advance and $20 at the door. Because access is limited, we list other Ponte Vedra events that are open to the public instead.
Are there train rides near Ponte Vedra?

Not in Ponte Vedra itself in the events we checked. In nearby St. Augustine, Ripley's Red Train Tours runs a 30 minute Nights of Lights ride with holiday music and magic glasses for riders. For rail history, Rally's Jacksonville Terminal and Florida East Coast Railway Society pages cover the area's lines.
